```yaml
name: Update Roadmap with New Tasks, Benchmarking, and DX

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install markdown

      - name: Read Current Roadmap
        id: read_roadmap
        run: |
          echo "current_content<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          cat docs/roadmap.md >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Generate New Roadmap Content
        id: generate_content
        run: |
          new_content="# Expanded Roadmap\n\n"
          new_content+="## Document Understanding Tasks\n"
          new_content+="- Table structure recognition\n"
          new_content+="- Key-value extraction\n"
          new_content+="- Reading order\n"
          new_content+="- Handwriting\n"
          new_content+="- Scene text\n"
          new_content+="- Document classification\n"
          new_content+="- Multi-page context\n"
          new_content+="- Figure/chart awareness\n\n"
          
          new_content+="## Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)\n"
          new_content+="- Realistic noise\n"
          new_content+="- Complex layouts\n\n"
          
          new_content+="## Modeling Additions\n"
          new_content+="- Quantization recipes\n"
          new_content+="- Confidence estimation\n"
          new_content+="- Serving example\n"
          new_content+="- ONNX/TRT export\n"
          new_content+="- Data mixing strategy\n"
          new_content+="- Experiment tracking\n\n"
          
          new_content+="## Benchmarking Additions\n"
          new_content+="- Robustness benchmarks\n"
          new_content+="- Commercial API comparison\n"
          new_content+="- Cross-dataset generalization\n"
          new_content+="- CI regression testing\n"
          new_content+="- Failure mode taxonomy\n"
          new_content+="- Domain-specific benchmarks\n\n"
          
          new_content+="## Developer Experience\n"
          new_content+="- Unified CLI\n"
          new_content+="- Tutorials\n"
          new_content+="- Model cards\n"
          new_content+="- Output format interop\n\n"
          
          new_content+="## Priority Order (Impact)\n"
          new_content+="- High: Document understanding tasks\n"
          new_content+="- Medium: Data augmentation, modeling additions\n"
          new_content+="- Low: Benchmarking additions, DX improvements\n\n"
          
          echo "new_content<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$new_content" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Append to Roadmap
        run: |
          echo "${{ env.current_content }}" > docs/roadmap.md
          echo "${{ env.new_content }}" >> docs/roadmap.md

      - name: Commit Changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "docs: expand roadmap with new tasks, benchmarking, and DX"
          file_pattern: docs/roadmap.md
          commit_user_name: github-actions[bot]
          commit_user_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
```
